verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts and models against well-defined inputs, launched from the console UI with a sample dataset and prompt, plus prompt-template setup via its MCP server. This is a first-party prompt-iteration capability, but the evidence never describes an interactive prompt playground, and the API-reference "Try it" runner is unrelated to prompt iteration. missing for 10: an explicitly documented interactive prompt playground, evidence of editing template variables and re-running live against selectable real models, details on side-by-side prompt iteration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.
You can use a sample dataset and sample prompt to create your first experiment.
